This '''CIS mining base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was there where [[Miner droid (Christophsis)|CIS Miner droids]] dropped off their load of [[force crystal]]s. It was used as a base and a factory for [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==History==
During the Clone Wars, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were investigating on the planet. They discovered the base and the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] from the CIS. Padmé and Rex instantly reported to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], but during the conversation, she and her protector were attacked and captured. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] then sent two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the planet to rescue the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], and investigate the scene. Soon after, however, two more Jedi were sent to the base along with Padmé, Rex, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. It was here that the Jedi learn of the ''[[Devastation]]'' from R2-D2 and C-3PO. Soon after, the two Jedi found [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and sought to attack when Dooku escaped.
